description:
Create a Catalog Price Rule named 'SUMMER_CLEARANCE_2025' that applies a 20% discount to all products in the 'Electronics' category. 

Configuration details:
- Rule Name: SUMMER_CLEARANCE_2025
- Status: Active
- Website: Main Website
- Customer Groups: 'NOT LOGGED IN' and 'General' only
- From Date: 06/01/2025
- To Date: 08/31/2025
- Priority: 2
- Action: Discount by Percentage of the Original Price
- Discount Amount: 20
- Stop Further Rules Processing: Yes

Navigate to Marketing > Promotions > Catalog Price Rules to create the rule. IMPORTANT: After saving, you MUST apply the rule for it to take effect.
